members.argument: Finland attracts 85% of Nordic defence funding, creating exceptional momentum for sovereign surveillance hardware (E21). members.headline: Early Finnish defence seeds rarely reach three million euros without trials.
members.argument: Typical Finnish early-stage defence checks cap around 1M to 1.5M, as shown by Metaktik and Kova Labs (E4, E13, E14). Furthermore, direct incumbents like Kelluu already secured 15M from NIF for persistent aerial surveillance (E3, E21, E24). Without announced defence trials or military contracts, closing 3M is unlikely (E4, E29).

members.headline: Military validation and syndicate structuring are mandatory before deploying capital.
members.argument: Finnish defence leaders succeed by formalizing trials with the Finnish Defence Forces or Border Guard early (E5, E6, E29). Furthermore, Cala graph shows key sovereign funds like Tesi and NIF already back competitor Kelluu (E21, E30). AeroRozum must demonstrate distinctive anti-jamming logistics and secure unconflicted seed leads like Lifeline or Maki (E4, E13).
